files.README.md:
# Notes

Create and browse up to 500 notes, stored in the app’s account-scoped SDK data store. Loading can be retried without clearing the form. An uncertain save keeps the same request ID and locks its text until retry, preventing duplicate inserts. Notes are displayed as plain text.
